links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, passive voice) of ChatGPT answers on chronic rhinosinusitis
links.effect: Across all categories mean Flesch Reading Ease was 40.42, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 12.13, passive voice 18.62%; treatment and complications answers were hardest (grade level 13.05). No significant differences across categories.
links.quote: Mean Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and passive voice percentage were (40.7%, 12.15%, 22.5%) for basic information and prevalence category, (47.5%, 11.2%, 11.1%) for causes and symptoms category, (33.05%, 13.05%, 22.25%) for treatment and complications, and (40.42%, 12.13%, 18.62%) across all categories.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT responses to chronic rhinosinusitis queries without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
